responsibility: Implements GCC’s main DWARF debug-info generator, covering both frame-unwind support integration and full DWARF debug section construction for compilation units. This file owns the creation and management of DIE trees, attributes, abbreviation tables, line tables, range/location lists, public-name/type indexes, macro info, split-DWARF/skeleton handling, section and label management, interactions with the generic debug hooks, and the final emission of the .debug_* sections and related tables from compiler trees, RTL, and source-location data.
same_name_distinction: Contains the full DWARF producer implementation, including DIE construction, section management, line/range/location data, and final .debug_* emission, and it invokes adjacent helpers such as dwarf2ctf. In contrast, dwarf2out.h exposes the reusable DWARF types, internals, and APIs that other modules inspect or call.
